purpose: Check Blender animation before the owner sees it: clean-walk check, camera smoothness plot, ray-block and too-close checks, hand and prop clash checks, and every frame reviewed on contact sheets by eye.

model.notes: running checks is mechanical; looking at the review sheets needs a model that reads images.

cost_flags: gpu time for the every-frame review renders (gpu-time grant)
owner_approval: GPU renders only under a current gpu-time grant
evaluation: The walk summary shows pass=True for every clip; the camera report has an empty too_close list and only intended blocked runs; the motion plot has no unexplained spikes; every review sheet was opened and its faults listed before the preview went out.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Blender Python checks plus Pillow scripts; rig and bone names change per character, thresholds stay.
